description: This is a Java source file defining the ModifyColumnGenerator class, which generates SQL commands to modify table columns across different database systems. The class handles validation, SQL generation, and supports various database-specific syntax nuances for altering columns.

classes.name: ModifyColumnGenerator
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractSqlGenerator to generate SQL statements for modifying table columns, supporting multiple database dialects.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Returns warnings about the modify column statement; currently returns an empty Warnings object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ModifyColumnStatement, checking for required fields and database-specific constraints, such as primary key limitations.

methods.name: generateSql
methods.description: Generates the appropriate SQL commands to modify columns based on the database type, handling variations in syntax and constraints.

methods.name: supportsExtraMetaData
methods.description: Indicates whether the database supports adding extra metadata like DEFAULT or PRIMARY KEY in the ALTER statement.

methods.name: getModifyString
methods.description: Returns the correct SQL modification keyword ('MODIFY' or 'ALTER COLUMN') based on the database dialect.

methods.name: getPreDataTypeString
methods.description: Provides the prefix string before the data type during column alteration, varying by database.

methods.name: getPostDataTypeString
methods.description: Provides the suffix string after the data type during column alteration, if needed by the database.

methods.name: getDefaultClause
methods.description: Builds the DEFAULT clause for the SQL command if a default value is specified and supported for the database.
